meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: Claude 会把附带的 Word、PPT、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 或文本型 PDF 在本地容器内转换成 Markdown 文件，并告诉您输出路径。转换不上传外部解析器。
howto.when: 当您发送消息并附带本地附件路径（如 /workspace/inbox/ 下的 Word、PPT、Excel 等文件），需要读取且不上传外部解析器时触发。

say.text: 请把附带的 Word 文档转成 Markdown
say.note: Claude 会在本地转换并给出输出文件路径。

say.text: 把附件里的 Excel 转成 Markdown，别上传
say.note: 转换不上传外部解析器，但数字格式可能有损。

say.text: 将这个文本型 PDF 转成 Markdown
say.note: 扫描件或图片版 PDF 会报不支持。

howto.what_en: Converts attached Word, PPT, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files to local Markdown using Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI in the agent container. Saves the output file and reports its path. No upload to external parsers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message supplies a local attachment path (e.g., Word, PPT, Excel files under /workspace/inbox/) that must be read without uploading to an external parser.

say_en.text: Please convert the attached Word document to Markdown
say_en.note: It will convert locally and give the output file path.

say_en.text: Convert the Excel attachment to Markdown, don't upload it
say_en.note: No upload to external parsers; number formatting may be lossy.

say_en.text: Convert this text-based PDF to Markdown
say_en.note: Scanned or image-only PDFs are not supported.
